about.name: Tomáš Kováč
about.bio1: I'm a passionate educator with a strong background in applied mathematics and physics. Over five years of tutoring secondary and university students, I've helped hundreds move from confusion to genuine mastery.
about.bio2: My approach combines structured methodology with patience. Whether you're catching up or aiming for top marks, I meet you where you are and build from there.

items.a: Standard sessions are 60 minutes. 90-minute deep-dive sessions are available for complex topics or exam preparation sprints.
Both. Online sessions use video call with a shared digital whiteboard. In-person sessions are available in Bratislava.

items.q: What age groups do you tutor?
items.a: Primarily secondary school students (ages 14–19) and first-year university students. I adapt my approach for each group.

items.q: How do I book a first session?
items.a: Send me a message via email or Instagram. We'll begin with a free 20-minute introductory call to assess your needs and set goals.
Yes. Custom problem sets, summary notes, and video explanations for every topic we cover — many available for free download.

about_page.title: About Me
about_page.subtitle: Educator, problem-solver, and dedicated tutor.
about_page.teaching_philosophy: Understanding beats memorization every time. My goal is to make you genuinely comfortable with the material — not just able to replicate a procedure, but able to reason from first principles. That's what separates good students from great ones.
about_page.background: I studied applied mathematics and physics and have spent five years teaching students across secondary school and university levels. My methods draw on cognitive science research: spaced repetition, active recall, interleaved practice — techniques that produce durable, transferable knowledge.
